patch.headline: 7.41f, sept 15 2026, after the MMR rescale to 1 to 9500
facts: facets are gone, innates scale with hero level or flat values, fewer draft variables
Tiny ate stacked nerfs in 7.41d and is fine, not freelo
Roshan and Tormentor swapped sides, Tormentor sits bottom low ground, spawns ~20 min, 3000 barrier shield, 30% damage reflect
neutral items are crafted, tier 1 exists at 0:00, full-clear camps to bank Madstone
rescale puts immortal draft at 8500, your first 10 to 15 calibration games outweigh the next 100
meta: Spectre and Lifestealer are S tier pos 1, Ogre and Axe top tier, PA, Storm, Jakiro, WK, TB, Slark, SF strong
corrections: tormentor: old advice said contest it at 20 for the shard. corrected: buy the shard with gold at 15+ when your spike needs it, treat the Tormentor as a 3-man post-fight objective, never solo it, never ping-beg for it

gold graph: old advice said check the gold graph. corrected: the gold graph is spectator and replay only, you cannot see it while playing. estimate enemy net worth from visible items (~items + 1k) and tower count, or subscribe to Dota Plus for the live net worth HUD
mid order: old sheet said WR first. corrected: BS > WR > DK everywhere

abaddon.identity: shield dispel hard support, aphotic shield purges stuns off allies, mist coil sustains the lane, borrowed time ignores focus fire
abaddon.why: hard support anchor, the shield dispel wins lanes and borrowed time soaks the dive
abaddon.how: shield the focus target to eat their stun, mist coil the last hit and the save, curse the engage, ult into their burst
abaddon.when: lane winner from level 1, frontliner all game, unkillable window every borrowed time cooldown
abaddon.build: holy locket, solar crest, mekansm, glimmer, aether lens, blink, agh
tech: tinker, slark, and kotl veto, mana burn and stat steal blank the shield economy
weaver and SF style squishy lines are the free wins, lanes well beside bounty or tusk lockdown
mechanics: tip
aphotic shield is a strong dispel, slap it on an ally to wipe stuns and most disables
tip
borrowed time can be manually cast while stunned, dispel yourself then shield the ally still stuck in the stun
tip
barriers eat damage before on-damage effects, blink and salve stay live under shield or borrowed time
counter
a hit larger than his current health skips the auto trigger, chip him low before dumping the nuke
counter
ice blast and culling blade kill through borrowed time below the kill check hp
counter
break him so it can't auto trigger, then silence so he can't manual cast, that is the full ult counter

alchemist.identity: gold engine bruiser, greevil greed stacks bonus gold on every kill, acid spray melts armor and waves, unstable concoction stuns on a cook, chemical rage turns him into a machine
alchemist.why: dedicated carry, greed outfarms every core and rage regen wins the manfight, favored into lifestealer and rubick, vetoed by lion and luna
alchemist.how: spray the wave and the camp, cook the stun behind fog, rage to dispel and disjoint, farm everything on the map
alchemist.when: outscales from the lane, hits the power spikes before the enemy cores, falls off late as answers land
alchemist.build: rad, manta, agh, bkb, assault, bloodthorn, abyssal blade
tech: lion, luna, and phantom lancer are the vetoes, hex chains delete the frame and illusions swarm
lifestealer, rubick, and juggernaut lines are the free wins, the greed tempo buries their timings
mechanics: tip
greed stacks bonus gold on chained kills, keep last hitting anything that moves to hold the cap
tip
the scepter synth melts one into an ally, they gain every upgrade while you keep bonus damage
counter
acid spray strips armor from everyone inside, standing in it invites the physical burst
counter
the concoction detonates in an area, never hug the target about to eat the stun
counter
the concoction throw cannot be disjointed, no blink or banish dodges it once airborne
counter
rage regen counts as health restoration, heal reduction cuts the manfight engine

anti-mage.identity: melee carry who blinks across the map farming it, mana break burns every target he touches, counterspell reflects the spell fired into it, and mana void detonates the emptiest pool on the field
anti-mage.why: dedicated pos 1, the blink is the fastest farm engine in the pool once the cleave comes online and the early game is the tax it charges, favored into underlord, undying, and SF lines, vetoed by dawnbreaker, earthshaker, and OD
anti-mage.how: farm the triangle, count the enemy mana pools, blink in after the disables burn, void the emptiest caster standing beside their friends
anti-mage.when: needs the free farm window, comes online as the map opens, dies to the early push that ends the game before the farm pays
anti-mage.build: bfury, manta, butterfly, skadi, abyssal blade, bkb, monkey king bar
tech: dawnbreaker, earthshaker, and OD are the vetoes, the global punishment and the burst catch the farm plan
underlord, undying, and SF lines are the free wins, the empty pools are free voids
mechanics: tip
blink disjoints incoming spell and attack projectiles
tip
hold mana void for the out of mana caster, the area damage scales with the missing pool
tip
mana void ministuns only the main target, casting it on a manaless unit still applies the stun
counter
roots and leashes stop the blink cast entirely
counter
break shuts off the mana break and the spell resist passive

arc-warden.identity: split push farmer clone, flux slows and burns a lone target, magnetic field dodges attacks, spark wraiths zone ground, tempest double duplicates everything
arc-warden.why: dedicated mid, the double farms both maps at once and wraiths hold ground free, favored into ember and necrophos, vetoed by legion
arc-warden.how: plant wraiths on every approach, flux the isolated target, field the tower siege, send the double down the empty lane, never fight in person
arc-warden.when: slow start until the farming engine spins, mid game double pressure everywhere, late game wins the race no core matches
arc-warden.build: midas, mjollnir, pike, manta, bloodthorn, skadi, sheepstick
tech: phantom lancer, legion, and magnus are the vetoes, illusions mute the flux and charges break the wall
ember, necrophos, and lina lines are the free wins, the field and wraiths outzone every immobile nuker
mechanics: tip
magnetic field pulls in every nearby rune and pops it on arrival, field the bounty spawn
tip
the double runs its own item and ability cooldowns, both of you cycle the same items twice
counter
flux deals nothing while any allied unit stands near the target, hug a creep or a teammate to mute it
counter
the field evasion only stops attacks from outside it, fight him from inside the bubble
counter
most spells treat the double like a hero, on-hit and steal effects all proc on it
counter
killing the double pays real gold and experience that scales with his level, hunt it when it overextends

bloodseeker.identity: melee agility core with a global thirst that hunts wounded heroes, blood rite silence zones, and a rupture ult that taxes every step
bloodseeker.why: dedicated mid, thirst tracks every low hp hero on the map and rupture blanks their kiting, favored into SF, QoP, and drow style squishy farmers
bloodseeker.how: blood rage the duel, blood rite the silence zone on their escape, thirst track the wounded, rupture the mover and run them down
bloodseeker.when: lane sustain from the rage healing, hunt windows once thirst comes online, strongest through the mid game before the ghost scepters and the kiting items land
bloodseeker.build: blade mail, rad, mjollnir, bkb, sange and yasha, agh, abyssal blade
tech: PA, spectre, and bounty are the vetoes, the evasion and the disengage blank the hunt
SF, QoP, and drow style farmers are the free wins, lanes well beside a lockdown support that feeds the rupture chase
mechanics: tip
blood rage amplifies every source of outgoing spell damage, item actives ride the amp too
tip
thirst exposes anyone under the health threshold with vision and true sight, the whole map sees the wounded
tip
learning thirst removes the movement speed cap outright, the hunt has no speed ceiling
tip
recasting rupture redeals the instant chunk and refreshes the debuff, it never stacks
counter
tp out of his gank, nothing in the kit stuns, roots, or leashes the channel
counter
instant repositioning skips the rupture tick, a max range blink or the tp scroll covers the distance in one burst
counter
break kills the thirst detection and the speed bonus, the cap removal and the kill healing survive it
counter
blade mail turns the rupture chase around, every step he forces pays him back

bounty-hunter.identity: track gold soft support that hunts roamers and wins the vision war
bounty-hunter.why: dedicated pos 4, track gold funds the team and wins the vision war, favored into sand king and timber style roamers
bounty-hunter.how: track every kill, hunt their roamer and wards, shuriken the tracked target
bounty-hunter.when: track pressure from level 1, strongest through the early game, rotate with the gold lead
bounty-hunter.build: essence distiller, vessel, ancient janggo, force, pipe, lotus, sheepstick
tech: ck and abaddon are the worst lanes, big game hunter stacks the track income
invis reveals flip the matchup, buy dust for the mirror and their sentry sweeps
mechanics: tip
shuriken bounces to tracked targets, open on a creep so it reaches the distant hero
tip
dust reveal and slow linger after leaving the radius, euls or lotus dispels it
counter
euls, manta, lotus, greaves, disperser all dispel track, so do allied dispels like aphotic shield
counter
track gold makes even trades pay, a 1 for 1 is really 1.5 gold for 1, don't coinflip fights into bounty
counter
essence distiller gives true sight on the debuffed target, it sees shadow walk

centaur.identity: hoof stampede tank, retaliate returns damage on every hit taken, double edge costs no mana, stampede tramples the map, hitch a ride shelters an ally
centaur.why: dedicated offlane brick, favored into lina and mirana lines, vetoed by juggernaut and dragon knight
centaur.how: edge the wave for free, body the lane with retaliate, stampede to save or to chase, hitch your carry out of a chronosphere
centaur.when: lane wall early, stampede answers fights across the map all game, aura frontliner late
centaur.build: helm of the dominator, blade mail, heart, pipe, lotus, shiva, bkb
tech: juggernaut, dragon knight, and outworld destroyer are the vetoes, spin and magic immunity shrug the trample
lina, mirana, and pudge style lines are the free wins, attack traders eat retaliate damage
mechanics: tip
double edge self damage is never lethal and costs no mana, spam it to shove waves
tip
retaliate still damages towers at half effect, draw the tower onto you while pushing
tip
stampede hurries every ally to max speed and the trample slows each enemy crossed once
tip
the hitched ally casts and attacks from the cart but cannot be targeted, non targeted effects still land
counter
retaliate only pays the attacker back when the attack lands, missed attacks never feed the return

crystal-maiden.identity: freeze control mana font hard support, crystal nova slows and scouts, frostbite roots the runner dead, arcane aura refills the whole team, freezing field storms the pit
crystal-maiden.why: hard support tempo anchor, favored into shadow fiend and ember lines, vetoed by arc warden clones and dawnbreaker saves, the field wins fights nobody expected
crystal-maiden.how: nova the engage for vision, frostbite the mobility hero, feed the lane mana, clone the channel, field the fight once their stuns are spent
crystal-maiden.when: lane mana wins the harass war, mid field tempo swings roams, late the field punishes clumped pushes
crystal-maiden.build: shard, blink, glimmer, force, ancient janggo, ghost, bkb
tech: arc warden, dawnbreaker, and sniper are the vetoes, clones and long range poke outrange the waddle
shadow fiend, ember, and mirana style lines are the free wins, squishy lines fold to frostbite plus field
mechanics: tip
crystal nova grants six seconds of flying vision around the cast point, scout rosh and deward with it
tip
frostbite is far more effective on creeps, root the big neutral to clear or steal camps
tip
crystal clone does not interrupt your channels, cast it mid freezing field or mid tp
tip
with the scepter the field stops channeling, she walks and casts freely despite the self slow
tip
hold the field until their disables burn and they forget you, one good channel flips the fight
counter
frostbite applies a root and disarm, it holds blinkers and mobility heroes in place

dark-seer.identity: wall of replica illusion flood offlaner, ion shell grinds the lane, vacuum stacks the fight, surge breaks the chase loose, wall copies their carry back at them
dark-seer.why: dedicated offlane grinder, favored into kez and shadow fiend lines, vetoed by faceless void and disruptor
dark-seer.how: shell the wave and grind, surge the engager in, vacuum the stack onto the wall, micro the replicas onto their backline
dark-seer.when: lane grinder from the start, vacuum wall wins the mid fight, replica flood scales late
dark-seer.build: mekansm, shiva, pipe, lotus, shard, bkb, sheepstick
tech: faceless void, queen of pain, and disruptor are the vetoes, chronosphere and escapes waste the wall
kez, shadow fiend, and tusk style lines are the free wins, illusion copies punish their melee cores
mechanics: tip
ion shell is castable on enemy units too, shell their melee core during a tower defense
tip
surge charges an allied unit with max speed and slow immunity, spend it on the engager
tip
wall replicas serve at your will until destroyed, order them onto the priority target
counter
the ion shell buff is dispellable by any dispel, supports with a dispel starve his lane pressure
counter
the surge buff is dispellable, any dispel strips the haste off the target

dawnbreaker.identity: tanky offlane initiator with global starbreaker ult presence
dawnbreaker.why: dedicated offlane brick, the global ult turns every fight into a 6v5, favored into SF style immobile mids
dawnbreaker.how: starbreaker lane trades, hammer into fights from anywhere, front line for your carry
dawnbreaker.when: lane brick early, ult windows all game, mid game monster once blade mail and harpoon land
dawnbreaker.build: blade mail, shard, harpoon, desolator, bkb, assault, abyssal blade
tech: visage and chen veto, nyx burns the ult economy
channel the global from fog, never in range of their stun
mechanics: tip
blink forward after the opening swipes to land the final starbreaker stun on top of a target
tip
solar guardian stun pierces bkb, debuff immune enemies still eat the landing
tip
once airborne she is invulnerable and hidden, nothing interrupts the landing, damage lands just before the stun
counter
silence cannot cancel a started starbreaker, stuns, sleeps, and fears all can
counter
nyx walks into solar guardian with carapace up and reflects the whole landing

doom.identity: melee strength offlaner with devour bonus farm, scorched earth chase speed, and a doom ult that silences one hero out of the fight
doom.why: doom mutes their engine hero out of the fight with items silenced, favored into timber, void, and morph style fight-carried cores
doom.how: devour farm, scorched earth chase, blink doom the engine hero
doom.when: devour accelerates the item plan all game, doom windows decide every fight once it comes online
doom.build: ancient janggo, midas, rad, shard, bkb, shiva, octarine
tech: timber, faceless void, morph are the jump-the-queue triggers, never doom the tank
meepo, brewmaster, visage veto, unit flood ignores single target doom
mechanics: tip
doom silences, blocks healing, and dispels on cast, one of the only spells that purges through bkb
tip
the level 25 talent adds break on top of the silence and heal ban
tip
self cast scepter doom is not a self doom, you just walk an aoe around
counter
infernal blade is his only stun, if he wastes it with no channel cancel you can tp out
counter
linkens and lotus are the answers, scepter self cast aoe doom plays around both
counter
hp set spells cheat the heal ban, sunder and scepter time lapse still work under doom

dragon-knight.identity: lane brick that counters magic mids
dragon-knight.why: counter pick into puck and TA, dragon blood blanks magic harass
dragon-knight.how: win lane by existing, stun their carry out of elder form, take towers behind it
dragon-knight.when: lane brick early, mid game tower monster in elder form
dragon-knight.build: rad, bkb, octarine, shiva, bloodthorn, assault, overwhelming blink
tech: break and heal cut turn dragon blood off, viper and huskar are the veto cluster
mechanics: tip
breathe fire cuts total attack damage including bonus damage from items, use it early in the fight
tip
corrosive breath burn works on towers, the dot is the whole early push package
tip
the transform itself is the gank, nobody respects the instant ranged stun out of knight form
counter
silver edge and viper strike carry the break, dragon blood regen goes with it
counter
vessel, skadi, ice blast, doom, even withering mist all cut the dragon blood regen

drow-ranger.identity: ranged aura anchor carry, frost arrows kite everything, gust silences and shoves, multishot blankets the cone, marksmanship pierces armor
drow-ranger.why: dedicated carry, favored into shadow fiend and necrophos lines, vetoed by dragon knight rush and spectre haunt
drow-ranger.how: frost the engage at max range, gust the caster wave, multishot the push, hold the high ground aura and kite the dive
drow-ranger.when: lane wins on frost range, mid game aura siege, late game falls to gap closers without spacing
drow-ranger.build: falcon blade, manta, pike, butterfly, silver edge, bkb, daedalus
tech: dragon knight, spectre, and phantom lancer are the vetoes, dive bodies and illusion spam collapse the range wall
shadow fiend, necrophos, and lina style lines are the free wins, paper ranged lines lose the aura war
mechanics: tip
gust reveals invisible units for the silence duration, the debuff grants true sight
tip
gust's knockback does not interrupt channels, it never cancels a teleport
tip
marksmanship procs cannot miss and pierce base armor, evasion is not an answer
tip
multishot arrows grant flying vision as they travel, sweep the fog line with a volley
counter
her passive drops when an enemy hero stands close, get in her face, illusions do not count

earth-spirit.identity: stone remnant brawler, boulder smash kicks units and allies out of trouble, rolling boulder turns invulnerable, grip silences from range, magnetize sticks the fight together
earth-spirit.why: dedicated mid, the roll ganks every lane and magnetize chains the disables, favored into SF and spectre, vetoed by legion and slark
earth-spirit.how: smash the remnant through the carry, roll in behind, grip the remnant to silence, magnetize the clump, reapply to keep the slow rolling
earth-spirit.when: roams the moment remnants allow, mid game lockdown peak, falls off late when the stoned targets outtank the magnetize
earth-spirit.build: vessel, blade mail, bkb, kaya and sange, shiva, octarine, bloodstone
tech: legion, slark, and techies are the vetoes, duel deletes the tempo and pounce leashes the roll
SF, spectre, and lina lines are the free wins, paper squishies melt to the roll combo
mechanics: tip
boulder smash kicks allied units too, boot a caught teammate out of danger across cliffs and trees
tip
rolling boulder turns invulnerable right after the windup, roll through the big spells and out
tip
grip any allied creep or hero, the enemies the pull passes through still eat the silence
tip
silence or slow one magnetized target and every magnetized enemy refreshes the same debuff
counter
stand in the roll's path, the boulder stops dead on hero contact
counter
he is only catchable while the roll winds up, once moving he is invulnerable

earthshaker.identity: melee initiator whose fissure stuns and walls the path, whose totem swings land as burst, whose every cast ripples an aftershock stun, and whose echo slam detonates off every enemy caught in the clump
earthshaker.why: dedicated mid, the burst deletes clumped fights and the fissure walls the rune and rosh pits, favored into weaver, SF, and underlord lines
earthshaker.how: fissure the lane and the gank, close on the clump, echo slam the fight, totem the follow up
earthshaker.when: roam windows from the first fissure points, strongest once the initiation lands inside their grouping, weak into spread splitpush drafts
earthshaker.build: shard, yasha and kaya, bkb, octarine, refresher, blessing, overwhelming blink
tech: dk, warlock, and sven are the vetoes, the tanky sustain and the cleave outlast the burst window
weaver, SF, and underlord lines are the free wins, the slam punishes everything they group
mechanics: tip
the fissure lands instantly along its whole line, and standing on it phases him through every wall
tip
the slam fully hits invisible and fogged units, there is no hiding from the echo
counter
every enemy in the slam rings echoes to the rest and real heroes ring twice, never clump into his fight
tip
the totem buff holds until a swing actually lands, prime it before the fight and walk in loaded

elder-titan.identity: aura sleep soft support, astral spirit roams and stacks damage, echo stomp sleeps the lane, natural order shreds armor and magic resist, earth splitter cracks the fight
elder-titan.why: soft support tempo anchor, favored into pudge and invoker lines, the stomp spirit combo wins the lane then the auras carry the mid game
elder-titan.how: send the spirit through creeps for damage, stomp onto the sleep setup, walk natural order onto their frontline, split the field with the crack
elder-titan.when: lane stomp threat early, mid aura windows peak with spirit returns, late auras still shred while the kit slows
tech: invoker and pudge are the only measured lines, both lean favorable, no vetoes clear the floor
pudge and invoker style lines are the free wins, stomp catches their channels and auras melt them
mechanics: tip
echo stomp sleep wakes early once the victim takes enough damage, hold your burst for positioning
tip
the spirit inherits the titans current move speed, send it out while sped up
tip
natural order armor shred centers on the titan, the magic resist shred centers on the spirit
tip
natural order strips only base armor and base magic resist, item granted defenses stay whole
tip
the spirit returns granting move speed and attack damage per enemy hero it crossed
counter
the astral spirit buff is dispellable, purge the move speed and damage off the titan

ember-spirit.identity: remnant mobility skirmisher, sleight of fist dances through the fight untouchable, searing chains root from the dance, flame guard soaks magic, remnants fly him across the map
ember-spirit.why: dedicated mid, sleight dance trades hp for free and remnant ganks hit every lane, favored into storm and SF, vetoed by arc warden and legion
ember-spirit.how: drop a remnant before you commit, sleight into the clump, chains the carry mid dance, flame guard the magic, fly out through the remnant
ember-spirit.when: fragile lane until the dance ranks, mid game skirmish king, late splits pushes and never dies
ember-spirit.build: vessel, mage slayer, shard, bkb, kaya and sange, shiva, blessing
tech: arc warden, legion, and tidehunter are the vetoes, the double outtrades the dance and duel steals the damage
storm, underlord, and jakiro lines are the free wins, the dance dodges their engage
mechanics: tip
searing chains cannot grab fogged or invisible units, but the chains reveal everything they catch
tip
you can cast during sleight, orders and spells flow free mid dance, only attack orders are locked
tip
sleight never disjoints, but the dash invulnerability eats projectiles that land inside the dance
tip
sleight marks and hits fogged units, dash the high ground to scout the clump
counter
sleight always returns him to the fiery replica of his start point, park your disable on it
counter
remnant travel speed scales off his own move speed, heavy slows gut his escape

enigma.identity: ranged offlaner with demonic conversion eidolon pushing, midnight pulse zones, and a black hole ultimate that wins teamfights
enigma.why: black hole wins the teamfight game, favored into BS and troll style clumped drafts, eidolons push the map
enigma.how: eidolon lane pressure and tower sieges, midnight zones, blink bkb hole the stack
enigma.when: eidolon push through the early game, hole windows every fight once blink and bkb land
enigma.build: ancient janggo, midas, blink, bkb, octarine, shiva, refresher
tech: lycan and meepo veto, unit flood overruns the eidolons
count their hole cancels before locking, a stack of rubick, sd, charge, or long silences means no enigma
mechanics: tip
midnight pulse chews trees in a huge aoe, it burns sprout and knocks a tree dancing mk off his perch
tip
midnight pulse deals full damage through bkb and debuff immunity, bkbd targets still melt in the zone
tip
spawn multiplied eidolons before a solo early black hole, the channel alone doesn't have the damage
tip
black hole silences on top of the stun, abaddon can't manually pop borrowed time and ursa can't enrage out
counter
primal roar, global silence, overgrowth, and rubick steal all cancel hole through debuff immunity, count them first
counter
walking away from a close range enigma eats an event horizon slow, respect the innate when disengaging

faceless-void.identity: melee carry with time walk damage rewind, time lock bashes, and a chronosphere that freezes the fight for his side
faceless-void.why: dedicated pos 1, chrono freezes their carry for the free kill, favored into SF and dark seer style fight cores
faceless-void.how: farm the time lock, time walk out of their burst, drop chrono on the carry and let the team clean the sphere
faceless-void.when: mask of madness and bfury open the farm, fight windows arrive with mjollnir and manta, bkb holds the sphere
faceless-void.build: mask of madness, bfury, mjollnir, manta, bkb, monkey king bar, butterfly
tech: spirit breaker and slark hunt him out of the sphere, juggernaut spin wastes the chrono window
shadow fiend and dark seer lines are the free wins, the sphere catches their flood
mechanics: tip
time walk flight is invulnerable, run head first into the projectile and rewind it
tip
time dilation stretches their cooldowns and slows per cooldown caught, combo heroes grind to a halt
tip
chronosphere carries true sight across the whole dome, shadow blade escapes die inside it
tip
his own units walk free in the sphere, even enemy void illusions are immune to the disable
counter
the sphere is a cylinder not a sphere, tree perchers get unperched on its edge
counter
backtrack is not evasion, accuracy never bypasses it, only evasion takes priority

hoodwink.identity: tree squirrel soft support, acorn shot plants and bounces, bushwhack nets to her trees, scurry skitters through woods, sharpshooter snipes across the map
hoodwink.why: soft support skirmisher, favored into prophet and jakiro lines, vetoed by bounty hunter tracking and ursa bursts, tree cover is her whole defense
hoodwink.how: plant the acorn tree, bushwhack the net onto it, scurry between woods for angles, hold sharpshooter for the rooted kill, bounce acorns to pop spellblock
hoodwink.when: lane pest with acorn harass, mid game tree ganks, late sharpshooter chunks from fog before fights break
hoodwink.build: essence distiller, glimmer, aether lens, blink, shard, gungir, sheepstick
tech: bounty hunter, spectre, and ursa are the vetoes, track gold and jump bursts end the squirrel games
prophet, jakiro, and sniper style lines are the free wins, slow bodies and treeline mazes feed bushwhack chains
mechanics: tip
mistwoods wayfarer redirects incoming attacks into a nearby tree, hug treelines for the free defense
tip
alt cast acorn shot to ground target and plant a tree anywhere inside the cast circle
tip
bushwhack grants flying vision around the latch tree whether or not it catches anyone
tip
the sharpshooter bolt fires automatically after the windup, juke the line instead of trying to cancel it
counter
destroying the tree a victim is bound to dispels the bushwhack debuff instantly

juggernaut.identity: melee carry whose blade fury spin shrugs off spells, whose healing ward sustains every push, whose blade dance crits scale the right clicks, and whose omnislash leaps between targets untouchable
juggernaut.why: dedicated pos 1, the spin blanks the magic burst and the slash isolates the locked target, favored into NP, centaur, and SF lines
juggernaut.how: spin the magic trade, ward the siege, crit the tank, omnislash the isolated target or the diving core
juggernaut.when: strong level gates through the mid game with the ward sustaining every push, dips into the kiting floods before the late items land
juggernaut.build: bfury, manta, butterfly, monkey king bar, skadi, swift blink, blessing
tech: OD, night stalker, and spirit breaker are the vetoes, the astral and the hunt blank the spin economy
NP, centaur, and SF lines are the free wins, the slash and the spin punish everything that commits close
mechanics: tip
blade fury does not interrupt his channeling, spin mid tp and the escape channel holds
tip
casting the spin is a basic dispel, the debuffs riding him wipe off as the storm starts
tip
the storm negates his own attack damage, the spin is the damage and the sword waits it out
tip
mid omnislash he still casts items and spells, the spin alone is locked out of the slash
counter
the slash hunts a short radius around him, outrun the jump range and the chain cuts early
counter
the healing ward dies to one hit and heals their whole team, kill it the moment it lands

kunkka.identity: ghostship admiral, torrent stalls from fog, tidebringer cleaves the wave, x marks returns anyone home, rum soaks the burst
kunkka.why: dedicated offlane crew captain, favored into lina and lion lines, vetoed by spirit breaker and phantom lancer
kunkka.how: cleave the wave with tidebringer, torrent from fog, mark their carry and drag the fight out, boat the engage for the rum
kunkka.when: cleave lane bully early, combo threat mid once the boat lands, rum carries the late fights

principles.name: count bodies
principles.body: single target damage loses to unit flood, AoE eats it. check the enemy hero count per fight before you lock: BS into PL or naga is a veto, warlock into PL is a 4.6 win.

principles.name: count mobility locks
principles.body: their mobility cores vs your lockdown. thirst hunts movers, entangle goes through escape buttons, rupture blanks dashes. if they have 3 dashes and you have 0 locks, do not fight them in open space.

principles.name: heal cut beats sustain, sustain beats burst
principles.body: necro and AA veto the spectre tank plan, silver edge breaks feast and dragon blood. when their kit heals, buy the cut, when their kit bursts, buy the sustain.

principles.name: know your side of the clock
principles.body: pre 15 lane winners (undying, hoodwink) vs 35+ scalers (spectre, AW, visage). your draft decides whether you force at 15 or farm to 35, never switch plans mid game.

principles.name: mechanics first, numbers confirm
principles.body: TP scroll blanks rupture, ghost scepter blanks right click divers, break blanks feast and dragon blood. these stay true below any stat threshold, the 1.5 filter only trims noise, never mechanics.

principles.name: economy is the only win condition you control
principles.body: 55+ cs at 10, 120+ at 20, 600+ GPM in free farm. at 2k the enemy carry averages ~450 GPM, beat him by 150 every game and most fights win themselves.

principles.name: objectives after advantages, trades after losses
principles.body: win a fight, take a tower, Rosh, or the tormentor. lose a fight, cut the dead lane wave or take their offlane T1. never lose a fight and then also lose 2 waves doing nothing.

principles.name: fixed info routines beat vibes
principles.body: glance the minimap on every last hit. the gold graph is spectator only: estimate enemy net worth from visible items (~items + 1k) and tower count, Dota Plus has a live HUD if you pay. check enemy buybacks before you walk high ground.

principles.name: shard law
principles.body: buy the shard with gold at 15+ when your spike needs it. the 7.41 tormentor has a 3000 barrier shield and 30% reflect on low ground bottom, it is a 3-man post-fight objective. never solo it, never ping-beg for it.

picker.intro: the pick simulator is the main tool, this page is the supplement: the pool reasoning lives here, the draft math lives there. keep both open while you draft.

cards.name: aim, search, enter
cards.body: click any empty board slot to aim the search at it: the aim chip names where enter lands (our pick, enemy pick, or ban) and reads board full when the draft is done, the aimed slot wears the ring. type a name, press enter, the hero lands in the aimed slot and the aim walks on: picks alternate to whichever side is behind, bans chain forward through the strip. click a filled slot to clear it. there is no mode toggle anymore, the board is the mode.

cards.name: the search covers the whole roster
cards.body: matching runs in tiers: exact name, prefix, initials (pl finds phantom lancer), substring, then fuzzy subsequence, so half a name is enough. legacy names still resolve through the alias map (furion, wisp, windrunner). an empty query browses the full roster in the legend's role order, pool heroes first with the repertoire dot; typed lists stay capped, the browse never is.

cards.name: read the ranking columns
cards.body: every row carries signed term columns plus the score. known mu: average matchup against the enemies already placed. known syn: synergy with the allies already placed, weighted for the role you are picking. prior: the hero's standing before any draft context, its within-pool rank on overall win rate. generic fit: expectation against the heroes nobody has picked yet. exposure: how much the candidate loses to popular unseen enemies, the score subtracts it. flex: a flatter matchup spread against likely enemies reads higher. gate: the authored veto and bonus rules, a fired rule can pin a note on the row, a veto tags it, and the list greys only when every candidate is vetoed. score is the weighted sum, recomputed on every board change.

cards.name: banners and chips tell you where you stand
cards.body: the phase banner tracks the draft (pick n/10, our pick, enemy pick incoming, bans n/16). on an empty board the ranking is expectation driven, the prior leads until picks land. a widened ranking means the selected role ran out of candidates and the list shows the whole pool with mismatch tags. meta chips pin the patch, the data date, and the bracket; rows add the hero's data position, the win-rate trend off the latest snapshots, and a veto tag when a veto rule fired. click any row for the full framework prose, the gate notes, and the lane-partner signal.
